method: The two m044 streams first run their second proposals using fresh CPU or GPU fields and the matching native or CUDA stationary solves. The subsequent fixed cohort includes the third proposals of these two streams and first proposals from fourteen independent PCG64 streams started at the qualified m044 injection. Each of four fits rebuilds every physical proposal. At scale both arms use the same compiled host eclipse solver and a bounded device owner supplies GPU fields. Sixteen finite physical resolutions guard each in-prior transition; all 256 old/new corner margins must agree on the decision. Accuracy and node stops preserve the exact starting checkpoint.
scope: Circular detached, unspotted reflected blackbody with linear limb darkening. Two reflection iterations, 18 input phases and 28 observations in B, V and bolometric light at nominal sigma 1e-4. Observations generated with the original 12-degree facet model. Inner branch of the Roche surface; original physical domain and unsupported-case semantics.
timing_boundary: Elapsed from loading and restoring the published, already-qualified physical checkpoint cohort through durable decisions and pool shutdown. Sampling starts after restoring the cohort. GPU owner launch, probe, fresh field creation, compilation, two-way transfers, synchronization, archive write/read and hold verification are included. Recomputing the original injection density, compiling the stationary library, science audits and covariance sensitivity are outside the measured cohort intervals. Each worker count and backend ran once, sequentially. The parallel arms compare CPU and GPU fields using the host stationary solver. The separate two-seed continuation used CUDA stationary solves.
